cases.why: A record as the registry serves it (an Edit, FullMetadata): default EIDR namespace plus md; schema-driven arrays (OriginalLanguage, AssociatedOrg, CountryOfOrigin, AlternateName, Director, Actor, EditClass, MadeForRegion) and singles (md:DisplayName in an org name, Parent).

Trimming of element content and attribute values (space, tab, CR, LF only; interior kept); empty attribute -> null; empty element and white-space-only element -> null; attribute-only element -> object of attributes; one occurrence of a repeatable element -> array; xsi:type kept as _xsi:type; text with attributes under "value".

xsi:nil="true" alone -> null; xsi:nil="1" with another attribute -> object including _xsi:nil; root attributes (xsi:schemaLocation) kept; the .api.json form removes the root element and keeps its declarations and attributes.
